gloss: distracting thoughts; idle thoughts; stray thoughts

definitions.gloss: distracting thoughts; idle thoughts; stray thoughts
definitions.explanation: Unwanted or irrelevant thoughts that interfere with concentration, meditation, or focused work. Originally a Buddhist term referring to thoughts that obstruct spiritual practice, now used broadly for any mental distractions.

examples.japanese: {雑念|ざつねん}を{払|はら}って{集中|しゅうちゅう}する。
examples.english: Clear away distracting thoughts and concentrate.

examples.japanese: {瞑想|めいそう}の{最中|さいちゅう}に{雑念|ざつねん}が{浮|う}かんでくる。
examples.english: Distracting thoughts come to mind during meditation.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}は{雑念|ざつねん}を{捨|す}てて、{勉強|べんきょう}に{専念|せんねん}しなければならない。
examples.english: Before exams, you need to cast aside distracting thoughts and devote yourself to studying.

notes:
USAGE:
{雑念|ざつねん} originally comes from Buddhist practice, where it refers to thoughts that obstruct meditation. In modern usage, it broadly means any unwanted mental distractions during focused activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑念|ざつねん}を{払|はら}う (to clear away distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}を{捨|す}てる (to cast aside distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}が{浮|う}かぶ (distracting thoughts arise)
- {雑念|ざつねん}にとらわれる (to be caught up in distracting thoughts)
- {雑念|ざつねん}を{振|ふ}り{払|はら}う (to shake off distracting thoughts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雑念|ざつねん}: distracting thoughts (interfere with focus)
- {邪念|じゃねん}: wicked thoughts, impure thoughts (morally negative)
- {妄想|もうそう}: delusion, fantasy (unrealistic imaginings)
